csv_project_name: Timber Lake Job Corps Fire Alarm Suppression &Testing
csv_scope_of_work: Job Corps Centers serve students and thus require life safety systems to be operational at all times to ensure safety of building occupants inthe event ofan emergency. This effort will provide all personnel, labor, equipment, tools, materials, instmments, meters, gauges, test equipment, transpoltation, supervision, and other items and services necessary to perform inspection and testing (11) for the Fire Alarm Systems (FA) & Fire Suppression Systems (FS) for the Timber Lake Job Corps Center located in Estacada, Oregon. Timberlake Job Corps is due for annual and 5 year inspection in accordance NFPA 25 code for CY2025. See appendix F for listed buildings and appropriate inspections. Buildings 1330, 1337, 1338, 1339, 1340, 1341, 1467, 1631, 1767, 2015, 2242, 2831, 2832, 2907, 3020, & 1332/ 1333 have fire alarm systems that are in service with 11 backflow devices. Drawings are attached that show layouts of the components.
csv_disciplines_requested: Inspection Services, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Utility Engineering
